fields.summary: Edge cases: header-only supplier file and file size limit
fields.description:
As a catalogue manager I want empty supplier files handled cleanly.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Uploading a supplier CSV that contains only the header row imports nothing and reports 0 imported and 0 rejected rows.
2. The product list page then shows 0 products.
3. Files larger than 10 MB are rejected before processing.
